_source: Fowl Play design doc pp. 11-13 (the Slop Shop). Sabotage lands on the target's next hunt; at most two per target per hunt; +50% on the leader.

sabotage.name: Rubber Ducky Rounds
sabotage.effect: Their first magazine is squeaky rubber ducks (no damage)
sabotage.counter: Reload early (the second magazine is normal)

sabotage.name: Butter Fingers
sabotage.effect: Their gun slips out of their hands twice (a 2 s pickup)

sabotage.name: Cardboard Sightline
sabotage.effect: A cardboard moose stands in front of their stall for 15 s

sabotage.name: Bee Hat
sabotage.effect: Bees round their head for 10 s; their aim sways wildly

sabotage.name: Decoy Rain
sabotage.effect: Extra decoys fly through their half of the sky (each hit costs $10)
sabotage.counter: Look carefully: decoys have no eyes

sabotage.name: Lens Smudge
sabotage.effect: A greasy blur on their screen for 20 s

sabotage.name: Reverse Controls
sabotage.effect: Their horizontal aim is inverted for the first 15 s

sabotage.name: Loud Neighbor
sabotage.effect: A bagpiper beside their stall all hunt; it drowns the bird cues

sabotage.name: The Dog's Grudge
sabotage.effect: The dog retrieves none of their birds; that hunt's money is halved at the end of the match
sabotage.counter: Feed the dog a sausage ($50) before the hunt

sabotage.name: Taxman
sabotage.effect: Takes 20% of their next hunt's winnings and gives it to the buyer
sabotage.counter: A lawyer ($100) returns it to sender

sabotage.name: Swap Meet
sabotage.effect: Swaps their primary gun with the buyer's for the next hunt
sabotage.counter: A lock box on the stall hook ($80)

sabotage.name: Ghost Pepper Snack
sabotage.effect: Their screen goes red and wobbly for 10 s

sabotage.name: Duck Repellent
sabotage.effect: Birds avoid their side of the field for 20 s

sabotage.name: Glitter Bomb
sabotage.effect: Their stall is covered in glitter for the match (cosmetic)
